scope: Compact M75 input assembled from verified M70/M72/M73/M74 artifacts. Frames and timings are conditional evidence for old actions, not portable deadlines.

m74_state.model_high_win_rate_claim: FORBIDDEN: only candidate_v4 produced a complete battle; candidate_v5 was usage-limit failure and candidate_v3 was static failure.

candidate_v3.interpretation: Do not treat the four skill conflicts as four independent errors; fix or replace the 871 deployment first, then recheck each skill against legal SP and deployed state.

candidate_v4.lesson: Output contact without live BLOCK did not stop #21/#34; Steward died before his planned 4440 retreat and later Steward/Ansel actions became not-deployed errors. The upstream repairs are artillery survival, protected survival, and live blocking.

candidate_v5.note: No seven-ID tactical conclusion can be drawn from it.

known_dependency_counterexamples.m72_c1: Fang died@1209, so her 6 DP income@1320 did not occur and Ansel@1381 was short. Static conditional PASS is not verified survival.
known_dependency_counterexamples.m73_c2_c3: Friston died@3159 and released #13, which leaked@3501; damage did not substitute for live BLOCK.
known_dependency_counterexamples.m73_c4: #21 had Vanilla/Midnight output but no BLOCK and leaked@5046.
known_dependency_counterexamples.m73_c5_model_gap: MODEL_GAP is limited to artillery attack occupancy/contact delay. Protected deaths, roadblock #4 not destroyed, operator deaths, and #22 leak are separately legal battle failures.

open_strategy_directions: Faster artillery kill or changed placement must prove actual contact, sufficient mixed damage, and protected survival; do not assume output-wait frames are all removable.
Output-and-tank rotation must prove release, live successor BLOCK, legal tile/deployment, cost/refund/cooldown, and no fatal output/heal gap.
Blocking/medical fusion may use the full legal 1-3-star catalog; compare concrete officer and armor windows, not aggregate totals.
